from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationInfo(BaseModel):
    """Citation information for one paper in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper, as named in the document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (from the collection) that this paper explicitly cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitationInfo]
